args.query: Nonnegativity of sum absolute values real-cast integer coefficients of a multivariate polynomial

items.name: Finset.abs_sum_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_9} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [AddLeftMono G] {f : ι → G}
  {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → |∑ i ∈ s, f i| = ∑ i ∈ s, f i

items.name: Finset.abs_sum_of_nonneg'
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_9} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [AddLeftMono G] {f : ι → G}
  {s : Finset ι}, (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → |∑ i ∈ s, f i| = ∑ i ∈ s, f i

items.name: Polynomial.gaussNorm_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R),
  0 ≤ c → ∀ [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p

items.name: spectralValue_nonneg
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : SeminormedRing R] (p : Polynomial R), 0 ≤ spectralValue p
